candidates.title: Late Sign-In Move Before Pet Generation
candidates.change: Moves the sign-in step after pet adoption certificate creation so users bond with their pet before committing an account.
candidates.why: Adoption step drops to 60.9% and has a 89s median time; asking for sign-in upfront causes early friction before value is demonstrated.

sign_in.headline: Save Your Companion to Your Account
sign_in.body: Sign in now so your newly adopted desktop pet is linked securely to your account and never lost.

guard.reason: Reordering sign-in after adoption certificate creation is explicitly permitted under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Reordering sign-in after value demonstration significantly reduces early drop-off at adoption (60.9%).

candidates.title: Desktop Controls Interactive Tutorial Walkthrough
candidates.change: Redesigns the home intro completion screen with an interactive checklist teaching users how to summon, hide, and talk to their desktop pet.
candidates.why: Support receives multiple inquiries regarding how to control or hide pets post-onboarding, and finish step conversion is only 64.8%.

home_intro.headline: Meet Your Desktop Companion!
home_intro.body: Try out these essential pet controls to make sure your desktop companion is active and responsive.

guard.reason: Redesigning the home intro screen into an interactive tutorial checklist is allowed within onboarding.

candidates.score_note: Interactive tutorial targets the 35.2% drop at finish and directly addresses support inquiries.

candidates.title: Interactive Desktop Placement Sandbox Screen
candidates.change: Adds a new sandbox screen during pet generation where users can practice placing and interacting with a test desktop companion.
candidates.why: The waiting step has high latency (median 201s, mean 2336s) and support reports pets failing to show on desktop after setup.

waiting.headline: Preparing Your Pet & Workspace
waiting.body: Your pet is being generated in the background. Step into the test sandbox while you wait!

guard.reason: _order names screens that are neither onboarding screens nor defined here: ['new_desktop_sandbox']

candidates.title: Photo Quality Verification Sub-Flow
candidates.change: Introduces an automatic validation step during photo upload that checks image clarity and gives instant visual pet previews before generation.
candidates.why: Support theme indicates custom pet generation fails or looks incorrect for users (3 tickets) and adoption completion is only 60.9%.

upload_photos.headline: Upload & Verify Pet Photo Quality
upload_photos.body: We analyze your image in real-time to guarantee high-fidelity pet rendering on your desktop.
upload_photos.hint: Clear, well-lit photos work best for custom generation.

guard.reason: Adding a photo quality verification sub-flow to the photo upload step is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Photo quality checks address custom pet failures and low conversion (60.9%) at adoption.

candidates.title: Desktop Display Health & Audio Completion Alert
candidates.change: Plays a playful desktop sound effect and sends a system tray notification when pet generation completes.
candidates.why: The mean time spent on waiting is 2336s because users tab away and miss when their pet is ready to appear.

waiting.headline: Your Companion is Almost Here!
waiting.body: Feel free to use other apps. We'll chime and notify your desktop the moment your pet arrives.

guard.reason: Adding audio cues and desktop notifications for completion during waiting step is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Audio and tray notifications recover users who tab away during long wait times (mean 2336s).

candidates.title: Existing Pet Account Recovery Sign-In Banner
candidates.change: Revises headline and copy on the sign-in screen to explicitly assure returning users their existing pets will be instantly restored.
candidates.why: Top support theme (8 emails) is pets missing or reset after signing back into an existing account.

sign_in.headline: Sign In to Restore Your Existing Pets
sign_in.body: Already have an account? Sign in to immediately load your saved companions and sync adoption data.
sign_in.hint: Your existing pet progress and inventory are safely stored in your cloud profile.

guard.reason: Updating sign-in copy to clarify account pet restoration complies with all onboarding rules.

candidates.score_note: Copy change directly targets the top support theme (8 emails) with minimal effort.

candidates.title: Adoption Certificate Cloud Sync Guarantee
candidates.change: Adds an explicit account preservation hint and cloud badge to the adoption certificate completion screen.
candidates.why: Prevents user anxiety about losing pets upon re-login, directly targeting the primary support complaint (8 emails).

adoption_certificate.hint: This adoption record is linked to your account. Your companion stays saved even if you switch devices.

guard.reason: Adding a cloud sync hint and badge to the adoption certificate maintains all required screen functions and complies with rules.

candidates.score_note: Low-cost hint addressing major account anxiety on a high drop-off step ( adoption 60.9%).

candidates.title: Welcome Starter Gift Incentive Banner
candidates.change: Offers an exclusive starter pet accessory item upon completing the onboarding intro screen.
candidates.why: Finish step drop-off is 35.2% (64.8% completion); an immediate reward motivates users to complete onboarding setup.

home_intro.headline: Claim Your Free Companion Accessory!
home_intro.body: Finish setup now to unlock an exclusive starter hat and toy for your new desktop pet.

guard.reason: Onboarding copy mentions 'Free Companion Accessory' and 'Gift', violating Rule 3.

candidates.title: Path Selection Visual Choice Cards Stage
candidates.change: Replaces path selection with a full stage layout featuring vivid visual preview cards for companion archetypes.
candidates.why: The choose_path step takes a mean of 514s with 76.2% conversion; clearer visual choices speed up decision-making.

choose_path.headline: Choose Your Pet's Companion Journey
choose_path.body: Select whether you want to adopt a ready-made companion or design a custom pet from scratch.

components.text: Standard Companion vs Custom Photo Pet

guard.reason: Redesigning choose_path with card layout retains both adopting and creating paths as required by Rule 2.

candidates.score_note: Visual cards help streamline choice latency (mean 514s) but require a full layout redesign.

candidates.title: Background Pet Generation Status Breakdown
candidates.change: Displays live step-by-step progress stages (Asset Rendering, Behavior Calibration, Desktop Hooking) on the waiting screen.
candidates.why: Users spend a median of 201s waiting without clear visibility into generation status, leading to support complaints about app stalling.

waiting.headline: Crafting Your Custom Desktop Companion...
waiting.body: Our engine is building your pet's 3D model, desktop collision physics, and unique personality traits.

components.text: Tip: You can drag your pet anywhere on screen after spawn.

guard.reason: Updating waiting screen status breakdown and progress features is allowed under Rule 4.

candidates.score_note: Detailed progress breakdown reduces perceived stalling during the 201s median wait time.
